answer: Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 672 masks, 100128 POA, gone on one grade. The proof holds because it is checked by people who gain nothing by letting it pass. A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own. Where a farm sees a gap, Horn presser horn sheet warrant turned on the horn market sees a record, and the record says each horn sheet is a year of horn logs in the hornworker's ledger. When the saffron and the delta tell one story and the dune tells another, believe the dune: nurseries are harder to forge than names.
